summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Consumer Staples ETF (RSPS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer staples equity. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of large-cap US consumer staples stocks drawn from the S&P 500. RSPS was launched on Nov 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: RSPS is an equity ETF with a total of 36 individual holdings. The top holdings are The Kroger Co. stock at 3.27%, The Procter & Gamble Company at 3.23%, Philip Morris International at 3.23%, Walmart at 3.18%, and Costco Wholesale at 3.17%.
